subject: post
title: (R)POST.------MTH.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-19. (R)POST — the reality of postulation — is crossed with MTH (methodology). Embedded in the part of the section where Braxton discusses the source-transfer implications of black creativity. The diagram poses: when postulation's *reality* (not its concept) is crossed with methodology, what is the structural chain? POST branches to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → C-AF-ALGN (composite affinity alignment) → PART (participation). Besides the main line POST → MTH, a second line runs POST → CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) → T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and T-C-IMP branches to INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) and to WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) → ALT-F (alternative functionalism) → AF-NT (affinity nature). The structural claim: real postulation reaches methodology directly, while information-affinity-basis is reached only via cross-transfer definitions and time continuum implications.
